title: Boundary cohomology of an open-extended pro-etale injective on a proper scheme
statement:
Let $Q=\operatorname{Spec}R$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum] in the universes of its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Assume that $R$ is w-contractible in the following explicit sense: every faithfully flat weakly etale ring map $R\to R'$ admits an $R$-algebra retraction $R'\to R$ [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map, def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. Let $z:Z\hookrightarrow Q$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with complementary quasi-compact open immersion $e:E\hookrightarrow Q$ [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Assume every point of $Q$ specializes to a point of $Z$, meaning that for every $x\in Q$ the closure of $\{x\}$ meets $Z$.
Let $p:P\to Q$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], set $P_E=P\times_Q E$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $h:U\hookrightarrow P_E$ be an open immersion whose image is also closed. Assume the composite $j:U\hookrightarrow P_E\hookrightarrow P$ is a quasi-compact open immersion. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $J$ be an injective sheaf of modules over the constant sheaf $A_U$ on $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then its extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero] satisfies
$$H^q(P_{\mathrm{proet}},j_!J)=0\qquad(q>0).$$
Here cohomology means the right derived functors of global sections in the category of constant-$A$ module sheaves, computed by an injective resolution [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. The sheaf $J$ need not have etale origin.

Pro-etale Tag 09AG, label lemma-jshriek-zero, gives only degree-zero specialization vanishing, not this higher-cohomology assertion. Neither tag is claimed to prove this pro-etale statement.
